channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Nicolas Claxton | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Nicolas Claxton from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Nicolas Claxton
item.description:
Erik Slater:Jordi Fernandez on Nic Claxton's back:

“The medical team has been addressing it. If he plays, it's because we believe he is 100 percent or 200 percent ready.”

Jordi Fernandez on Nicolas Claxton, Nov 22, 2024. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Nicolas Claxton
item.description:
BrooklynNets coach Jordi Fernandez on Nicolas Claxton:

“I believe he’ll be the Defensive Player of the Year for us. He’s a priority this summer.”

Jordi Fernandez on Nicolas Claxton, Apr 24, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Sean Marks on Nicolas Claxton
item.description:
Michael Scotto:Nets GM Sean Marks on Nicolas Claxton:

“Nic is the No. 1 priority for us, there’s no doubt about that. We hope he’s a Net for a very long time. We hope we can continue to build around him and with him.”

Sean Marks on Nicolas Claxton, Apr 24, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Dennis Schroder on Nicolas Claxton
item.description:
Dennis Schroder on his pick-and-roll pairing with Nic Claxton:

“He sets a big-time screen... He puts a lot of pressure on the rim rolling, so the pocket pass and the oop plays are always open. When we get that chemistry right in practice it’s going to be big-time for our team.”

Dennis Schroder on Nicolas Claxton, Feb 10, 2024. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.
